modules.name: Web Panel
modules.description: The web-based admin interface with a side menu, top bar, project selector, list tables and detail side panel.

requirements.title: Left side menu, top bar and project selector
requirements.description: The web panel has a left side menu, a clean top bar and a project selector.

requirements.title: Searchable, filterable, sortable tables
requirements.description: Tables offer search, filters by project, status, category and date, sorting, and saved filters.

requirements.title: Status as colour labels with text
requirements.description: Status is shown as colour labels that also carry text.

requirements.title: Details open in a side panel
requirements.description: Record details open in a side panel so the user keeps their place in the list.

requirements.title: Bulk actions where useful
requirements.description: Bulk actions are supported where useful, such as assigning many complaints at once.

requirements.title: Support screens 1280 px and wider
requirements.description: The web panel works well on screens 1280 px and wider.

requirements.title: Tablet support (Should Have)
requirements.description: Tablet support is a Should Have.
